feed.h: Damon Jones is the first to plead guilty in the NBA gambling cases
feed.b: He pleaded guilty to two wire-fraud conspiracy counts, covering betting on nonpublic injury information and the rigged poker games.

src.t: Ex-NBA player Damon Jones 1st to plead guilty in gambling case

feed.h: Test accounts set up as 15-year-olds were shown gambling promotions on TikTok, YouTube and Instagram
feed.b: The Institute for Strategic Dialogue found all three platforms surfaced betting and prediction-market content, mostly through influencers and athletes.

feed.h: More than half of men aged 18 to 49 have an active online sportsbook account
feed.b: Siena's survey found 27% of all Americans and 52% of men 18 to 49 had an active account, up from 22% and 48% a year earlier.

feed.h: DraftKings, FanDuel, Fanatics and bet365 revealed as funders of a new super PAC
feed.b: Axios reported Win for America had spent more than $20 million across six states and planned to get involved in 15 more.

src.t: Exclusive: DraftKings, FanDuel, Fanatics fund sports betting super PAC
